requirements.quote: Add notification categories and a worker job/schedule that raises exception alerts for portfolio cases (new adverse order, missed date) to the institution's users
update apps/worker registry.test.ts and schedules.test.ts and the notification category tests

deliverables.change: add categories 'portfolio.adverse_order' and 'portfolio.missed_date' (defaultChannels in_app,email,push; not mandatory; comment citing #665)
add the two keys to the exact-list expectation

new scanPortfolioAlerts({db,enqueueDelivery,now?}, workspaceId): inside withWorkspace find cases with lastAdverseOrderAt in last 7 days and cases with nextDate before today (IST); notify each active member via notify() with dedupe keys portfolio-adverse:<caseId>:<ref or epoch> and portfolio-missed:<caseId>:<nextDate>; cap cases per run; return counts; idempotent
new job system.portfolio-alert.scan modelled on judgment-alert-scan.ts: daily cron 06:00 IST, targets via app_portfolio_alert_targets(), per-workspace try/catch, injectable deps
import and register portfolioAlertScan in definitions and the JobMap type tuple

CREATE FUNCTION app_portfolio_alert_targets() SECURITY DEFINER returning workspace ids of non-deleted institution organizations that have portfolio_case rows; REVOKE from PUBLIC, GRANT to causedeck_app (same shape as 0073). Use the next free timestamp if taken; update meta journal/snapshot as other migrations do
register scanPortfolioAlerts in SERVICE_TESTS (self-scoped or denies) with a real case in the cross-tenant portfolio test
case: scanning workspace B notifies only B's members and leaves A unchanged
integration test: seeded institution with an adverse-order case and an overdue case alerts every active member once; second run adds nothing; non-institution/other-workspace users get nothing
job test modelled on judgment-alert-scan.test.ts (targets listed, failure isolated)
add 'system.portfolio-alert.scan' to the expected scheduled names
add 'portfolio' to the jobs domain dependency list
document scanPortfolioAlerts in the portfolio row and add portfolio to the jobs dependency row and graph

preserve.what: Existing portfolio exports and behaviour (importPortfolioCases, listPortfolioCases, portfolioSummary, exportPortfolioCsv) in packages/core/src/portfolio/
Existing notification categories and their defaults in packages/notifications/src/categories.ts; notify() semantics in packages/notifications/src/service.ts
Other scheduled jobs and their cron in packages/core/src/jobs/registry.ts

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/portfolio src/jobs/definitions/portfolio-alert-scan.test.ts src/__tests__/cross-tenant/portfolio.test.ts src/domains.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/worker exec vitest run src/__tests__/registry.test.ts src/__tests__/schedules.test.ts

decisions.choice: Use an owner-defined SECURITY DEFINER targets function plus per-workspace scan rather than reading portfolio_case directly in the job
decisions.justification: The job has no workspace and tenant tables are FORCE RLS; same pattern as migrations/0073_judgment_alerts.sql and jobs/definitions/judgment-alert-scan.ts

decisions.choice: Dedupe via notify() dedupeKey instead of new state columns, so no schema change beyond the function
Add portfolio to the jobs domain dependencies
decisions.justification: jobs imports other domains only through index.ts; domains list in packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js and docs/engineering/core-domains.md (CLAUDE.md registries table)
